CliffsideCove_Text_Npc0.en: Nobody comes here. Except me and\nWINGULL.
CliffsideCove_Text_Npc0.fr: Personne ne vient ici. Sauf moi et\nGOÉLISE.

CliffsideCove_Text_Npc1.en: The tide covers the path at night.
CliffsideCove_Text_Npc1.fr: La marée recouvre le chemin la\nnuit.

CliffsideCove_Text_ReturnAsk.en: Ready to go back to the dock?

CliffsideCove_Text_Stay.en: Take your time. The tide can wait.
CliffsideCove_Text_Stay.fr: Prends ton temps. La marée peut\nattendre.
